product_summary: Hand tools / forging-based tool maker. Corroborated product lines: hand tools generally (listed as exhibitor in the hand-tools & hardware segment of International Hardware Fair India 2026, New Delhi, 23-25 Oct 2026, alongside Taparia Tools, Vishal Tools & Forgings, Shiv Forgings/BAUM - source: https://edu-news.net/news/international-hardware-fair-india-2026-to-bring-the-tools-and-hardware-industry-together-from-23-25-october-in-new-delhi). The 'Jhalani Expert' brand is traded as a professional hand-tool line (spanners, pliers, hammers, tool kits) by authorised dealers, e.g. A Faizullabhoy & Co, Kolkata, which stocks 'Jhalani Expert' alongside Taparia/Eastman hand tools (source: https://www.indianyellowpages.com/kolkata/a-faizullabhoy-co-10944980/). 'Jhalani' is also named as a hand-tool brand in Moglix's hand-tools buying guide (source: https://www.moglix.com/buyer-guide/hand-tools). No own website or downloadable catalogue could be opened in this session (jhalaniforge.com did not resolve; search backend returned no results), so the exact SKU list is not verified.
role_hint: manufacturer (forge-based tool producer; 'Forge' in the legal name plus forging-tool peer group at IHF India). Trader signs: none observed - the company appears as a producer/exhibitor, not as a reseller of third-party brands. Cannot be confirmed from a primary source in this session.
comment: Declared 820320 (pliers/pincers/tweezers), 820411 (non-adjustable hand-operated spanners/wrenches) and 820559 (other hand tools) are consistent with a hand-tool forging manufacturer and are retained. Status: partial - the declared set covers the core lines but is narrower than the evident range. Missing from the declaration, on the evidence of the brand's traded range: 820412 (adjustable spanners/wrenches), 820520 (hammers/sledgehammers - drop-forged claw hammers are a standard forging-tool item), 820540 (screwdrivers), 820551 (household hand tools), 820570 (vices/clamps) and 820600 (tools of two or more of 8202-8205 put up in sets for retail sale - relevant if tool kits are sold). Industry label 'Строительство и DIY' (construction & DIY) is a downstream end-use label, not the company's industry: the company belongs to hand tools / forgings (HS ch. 82), so the industry classification is imprecise rather than wrong. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground - company is kept and the code set is corrected/extended as above. IMPORTANT: every product statement above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' - no customs line, invoice or shipment record was checked in this task (out of scope), and no primary company catalogue was readable, so none of the HS codes is corroborated by a customs entry. No PAN, CIN, revenue or export volume was researched or asserted here; those fields are null for this task.
